The all-k proof is mathematical: Taylor/Hensel period lifting, unit quadratic character invariance and root counts; k<=6 exhaustive computations are independent consistency checks only.
correctness.rationale: On Z/5^k, k>=1, residues 2 and -1 mod5 are periodic disks; 1,3 have depth 1 and 0 depth 2. The p-adic period-lifting lemma for g congruent to identity derivative modulo 5 and displacement valuation >=2 establishes cycle lengths 2*5^(k-t-1) in 2-disk and 4*5^(k-t-1) in -1-disk, with fixed roots 2,-1 and total 3k-1 cycles. On each near-2 valuation shell, the normalized quadratic character epsilon distinguishes the two same-length cycles. Incoming depth-2 roots of z+2 via Hensel have count 5^floor(k/2) at 2, 2*5^(t/2) exactly at even t with epsilon=+1, zero otherwise; no deeper branches. Thus complete rooted graph with multiplicities.
risks: The valuation-lifting lemma needs h>=2; the proof applies only to f^2 or f^4 with displacement valuation t+1>=2, not arbitrary tangent maps at h=1.
The periodic part is largely covered by 2026 general Chebyshev period theory and is not offered as original.
